static_traits.name: Zhang Bowen
static_traits.occupation: Proofreader at a greeting card company
static_traits.family_status: Parents' marriage is stable; married for 40 years
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive group of friends, but has not yet discussed negative thoughts with them
static_traits.medical_history: Not yet had similar psychological problems; no past psychotherapy history; No major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I am distressed by negative thoughts arising from my favorite rugby team's recent losses, leading me to believe the whole season is ruined.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts have affected my ability to enjoy activities such as watching football matches.

core_beliefs: Things are either perfect or utterly worthless

special_situations.event: Favorite team lost last week's game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one match is lost, it means the whole season is doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to distract oneself with other hobbies and activities, but avoiding discussing this matter with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The whole season is ruined; they will not win other games in the future either

special_situations.event: Before or while watching subsequent games (with no results yet)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they might lose this game, it means they will also lose the following games
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on negative details when watching, to confirm worries
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This game will most likely be bad again; no hope for the playoffs

special_situations.event: Post-game review after the team loses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failure shows positive factors are all unimportant or do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring team coordination and progress, only repeatedly focusing on mistakes and inadequacies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those good performances are all not worth mentioning; losing is total negation

special_situations.event: When thinking about sharing one's troubles with friends or when friends talk about matches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express these thoughts, friends will think I am exaggerating and judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing competitions and feelings with friends, staying silent to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will find me too dramatic and will not understand me

core_conflict.wish: Longing for certainty and perfect outcomes (continued winning seasons, not being disappointed)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of disappointment and loss of control from failure and uncertainty
defense_goal: Simplifying complex situations with black-and-white rules to lower Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: Worries about being seen as an 'overreacting' fan; prone to falling into negativity due to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Friends imagined as non-understanding, judgmental people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of sharing these negative thoughts with friends or friends mention competitions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes friends will find her dramatic and not understanding (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to avoid sharing, stays reserved; if a response is needed, uses a tactful, low-intensity tone, expresses briefly, avoiding deeper details.

manifestations: Believing one loss makes the whole season meaningless
Finds it hard to enjoy originally liked activities (reading, watching movies, watching ball games)
outcomes: Reduced investment in competitions and daily activities

manifestations: Having supportive friends but not sharing distress, worrying about seeming dramatic
Relations with family and friends become tense due to negative thinking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming friends will find one exaggerated and not understanding
Thus unwilling to discuss negative thoughts with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Repressing impulses to express outwardly and seek support
Choosing to bear it alone and not communicating with friends

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends
Work and occupational functioning basically intact (Work performance not yet affected)
Willing to seek help and try new coping approaches
negative_force: Overgeneralization and catastrophizing predictions about the future
Mental filtering, focusing only on negative details
Negating positive thinking, struggling to acknowledge positive factors
Avoiding communication with others out of fear of being judged

target_behavior.behavior: After the team's loss, repeatedly ponders and asserts 'the season is ruined', and avoids discussing with others
antecedent: Anticipation before a new game begins
target_behavior.core_reason: Understands competition results with a black-and-white cognitive rule, and overgeneralizes one failure into a long-term disaster to seek certainty
target_behavior.function: Gaining psychological certainty by simplifying to 'all good or all bad', avoiding facing disappointment and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty enjoying watching games and other activities; Relationship tension with family and friends, Social interaction affected
